selection.rule: 145 bigrams drawn without replacement from the handwriting bigram candidates (letter bigrams with >= 20 aligned IAM observations), with probability proportional to IAM text count ** alpha (Gumbel top-k, random.Random(seed)); alpha on a 0.001 grid in [0, 2] minimizes |IAM characters per token - handwriting partner|; draws further than 0.001 from the partner are skipped
